domain: Whether the institutionalization of workplace wellness programs genuinely reduces occupational illness, or whether the programs partly manufacture the wellness metrics they claim to measure.
topic: Whether the institutionalization of workplace wellness programs genuinely reduces occupational illness, or whether the programs partly manufacture the wellness metrics they claim to measure.

source.title: This Data Center Is Everything That Everyone Hates About AI

movement.gist: Establish that modern corporations have built vast wellness apparatus—screening, monitoring, intervention—that measurably reduces reported illness. Frame this as triumph of applied occupational health.
Objection: the screening itself may create the diagnostic categories it then treats. The act of measurement reshapes what it measures.

Concede that yes, the infrastructure's categorization practices do shape outcomes—stress becomes 'codifiable stress,' fatigue becomes 'quantifiable fatigue'—yet argue this does NOT undermine the thesis because real suffering was always there, only now addressable.

The original claim reasserts: wellness programs do reduce illness rates. The causal mechanism includes both genuine intervention AND metric-creation. The thesis (that they work) survives the concession intact.

Tally the cost: workers now live under constant wellness surveillance; their bodies are perpetually legible to the corporation; the reduction in reported illness is real, but purchased by converting the private fact of suffering into an auditable institutional asset. Close by scaling up: this pattern repeats across all domains where measurement systems precede the phenomena they measure.

poles: wellness infrastructure discovers and treats real workplace pathologies
wellness infrastructure creates the measurable pathologies it purports to address
programs genuinely improve worker health despite their performative elements
programs primarily serve employer liability reduction and optics

tension_system.interaction: The primary tension resolves (both causation directions are simultaneously true), but this resolution leaves the secondary tension unresolved—we cannot say whether the real improvements justify the infrastructure's hidden function.

family_realization.note: Thesis defended and diminished perfectly. Passage affirms gains ('illness figures fall, truly') while tallying cost ('price of being helped is being seen'). Tone holds triumph-and-loss simultaneously throughout.

ending_behavior.note: Final two sentences leap from occupational health to 'schooling, in policing, in the quiet metrics by which we are all increasingly known'—genuine scale jump. Aperture widens; resolution costed.

voice_consistency.note: Reluctant modernist sustained: 'I distrust novelty, and I confess a nostalgia' but 'honesty compels me.' Concrete particular: 'machinist with the ruined shoulder.' Some unevenness: 'the bill' metaphor shifts tone slightly mid-paragraph.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(C) stance_misread trap catches readers who miss 'bill.' Q5(C) adjacent_answer snares those focusing on worker discomfort rather than artifactuality. Q7(A) half_truth requires distinguishing genuine harm-reduction from permanent-record claim.

explanation_quality.note: Every wrong option ties to specific mechanism: causal_inversion names paragraph reversals; terminological_twin flags stance-misreads; scope_inflation pinpoints overgeneralization. All cite passage locations precisely.

answers.reasoning: Passage balances genuine benefit against real cost of permanent visibility; thesis matches.
Pain pre-existed; measurement gives it addressable coordinates institutions must answer for.
'The bill' introduces the cost: permanent legibility/auditability of worker's body.
Machinist example shows pain existed before categorization, countering the invention objection.
If reductions merely reflect narrowed categories offsetting rising untracked illness, gain is artifact.
Air sensors both reduce pollution and create permanent surveillance record, mirroring dual mechanism.
Directly parallels health case: reduced harm plus permanent monitoring records in other domains.
Text explicitly calls mechanism 'double—part genuine repair, part the very act of naming.'
